description: This Java test file contains integration tests for the persistence layer related to filtering criteria within the 'thingsearch' service. It tests various criteria-based searches on attributes of 'things' (such as string, number, boolean, and regex attributes), including equality, inequality, comparison operators, and pattern matching.

classes.name: FilterCriteriaIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying filtering criteria logic in the persistence layer of the 'thingsearch' service, extending a base test class for read persistence tests.

methods.name: createTestData
methods.description: Prepares test data by inserting 'things' with specific attributes into the persistence layer before each test execution.

methods.name: findAllByEqString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'things' with attribute 'stringAttr' equal to a specific string value.

methods.name: findAllByEqNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'things' where 'numberAttr' attribute equals a specific number.

methods.name: findAllByEqBoolean
methods.description: Tests retrieval based on boolean attribute equality.

methods.name: findAllByNeString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'things' where 'stringAttr' is not equal to a specific value.

methods.name: findAllByNeNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval for 'numberAttr' not equal to a specific number.

methods.name: findAllByNeBoolean
methods.description: Tests retrieval for boolean attribute 'not equal' condition.

methods.name: neIsEqualToNotEq
methods.description: Verifies that 'not equal' criteria are equivalent to the negation of 'equal' criteria.

methods.name: findAllByGtString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'things' where 'stringAttr' is greater than a specified string.

methods.name: findAllByGtNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval where 'numberAttr' exceeds a certain number.

methods.name: findAllByGtBoolean
methods.description: Tests 'greater than' comparison on boolean attribute (likely based on boolean ordering).

methods.name: findAllByGeString
methods.description: Tests retrieval for 'stringAttr' greater than or equal to a specific string.

methods.name: findAllByGeNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval for 'numberAttr' greater than or equal to a number.

methods.name: findAllByGeBoolean
methods.description: Tests 'greater than or equal' comparison for boolean attribute.

methods.name: findAllByLtString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of 'things' where 'stringAttr' is less than a specific string.

methods.name: findAllByLtNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval where 'numberAttr' is less than a given number.

methods.name: findAllByLtBoolean
methods.description: Tests 'less than' comparison on boolean attribute.

methods.name: findAllByLeString
methods.description: Tests retrieval for 'stringAttr' less than or equal to a specific string.

methods.name: findAllByLeNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval for 'numberAttr' less than or equal to a number.

methods.name: findAllByLeBoolean
methods.description: Tests 'less than or equal' comparison for boolean attribute.

methods.name: queryByLikeString1
methods.description: Tests pattern matching with 'like' for attribute 'stringRegex' starting with a pattern.

methods.name: queryByLikeString2
methods.description: Tests pattern matching with 'like' for attribute 'stringRegex' containing a pattern.

methods.name: queryByLikeString3
methods.description: Tests pattern matching with 'like' for attribute 'stringRegex' with wildcards.

methods.name: queryByLikeString4
methods.description: Tests pattern matching with 'like' for attribute 'stringRegex' ending with a pattern.
